title: Outweigh
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There are $N$ types of stones, $1,2,\dots,N$. Stones of the same type all have the same weight.
Takahashi and Aoki have $A_i$ and $B_i$ stones of type $i$, respectively.
Determine whether there exists a sequence of positive integers $W=(W_1,W_2,\dots,W_N)$ satisfying the following conditions, and if it exists, construct one such sequence.

- $1 \leq W_i \leq 10^{18}$
- If the weight of a type-$i$ stone is $W_i$, the total weight of the stones Takahashi has is strictly greater than the total weight of the stones Aoki has.

## Constraints

- $1 \leq N \leq 10^5$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$
- $1 \leq B_i \leq 10^9$
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
A_1 A_2 \ldots A_N
B_1 B_2 \ldots B_N
```

## Output

If there exists $W=(W_1,W_2,\dots,W_N)$ satisfying the conditions, output it in the following format:

```
Yes
W_1 W_2 \ldots W_N
```

If there is no $W=(W_1,W_2,\dots,W_N)$ satisfying the conditions, output `No` in one line.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

有 $N$ 种石头，编号为 $1,2,\dots,N$。同一种石头的重量均相同。
Takahashi 和 Aoki 分别拥有 $A_i$ 块和 $B_i$ 块第 $i$ 种石头。
请判断是否存在满足以下条件的正整数序列 $W=(W_1,W_2,\dots,W_N)$，若存在，请构造一个这样的序列。

- $1 \leq W_i \leq 10^{18}$
- 当第 $i$ 种石头的重量为 $W_i$ 时，Takahashi 拥有的石头的总重量严格大于 Aoki 拥有的石头的总重量。

## 约束条件

- $1 \leq N \leq 10^5$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$
- $1 \leq B_i \leq 10^9$
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入通过标准输入以如下格式给出：

```
N
A_1 A_2 \ldots A_N
B_1 B_2 \ldots B_N
```

## 输出格式

若存在满足条件的 $W=(W_1,W_2,\dots,W_N)$，请以如下格式输出：

```
Yes
W_1 W_2 \ldots W_N
```

若不存在满足条件的 $W=(W_1,W_2,\dots,W_N)$，请在一行中输出 `No`。

samples.note:
If $W=(4,7,4)$,
the total weight of the stones Takahashi has is $4 \times 4 + 7 \times 7 + 4 \times 4=81$.
The total weight of the stones Aoki has is $4 \times 5 + 7 \times 5 + 4 \times 5=75$.
